stem.text: The graph shows the changes in blood pressure and water potential across a blood capillary from the arterial end of the capillary to the venous end of the capillary.

stem.alt: Graph of blood pressure and water potential against distance along a capillary from arterial end to venous end, with a falling solid line labelled blood pressure and a dashed horizontal line labelled water potential of plasma.

stem.text: What could result in an accumulation of excess tissue fluid?

A.text: an increase in concentration of large proteins in the blood plasma

C.text: a decrease in the concentration of small proteins in tissue fluid
